fix: honour a falsey validator in bucket (#1308)
`bucket` chose its validator with `validator or (lambda x: True)`, so a
falsey but valid callable (e.g. an empty `set` subclass defining
`__call__`) was silently replaced by the default that accepts every key.
Selecting such a bucket then returned items the validator rejected, and
membership tests wrongly reported them present.
Use an `is None` check instead.

Fix this issue so that the failing tests pass: test_falsey_validator_is_honoured

Fix one()/only() dropping a falsy user-supplied exception

Fix one()/only() dropping a falsy user-supplied exception
`one(it, too_long=exc)` and `only(it, too_long=exc)` used
`raise too_long or ValueError(msg)`, so a `too_long`/`too_short` whose
instances are falsy (e.g. an Exception subclass overriding `__bool__`)
was discarded and the default `ValueError` raised instead.
Switch to explicit `is not None` checks, and only build the default
message when no custom exception is supplied so a faulty `__repr__` on
the iterable's items can't shadow the requested exception.

Fix this issue so that the failing tests pass: test_falsy_custom_exception, test_too_long_does_not_evaluate_repr, test_falsy_custom_exception

Fix one()/only() dropping a falsy user-supplied exception

`one(it, too_long=exc)` and `only(it, too_long=exc)` used
`raise too_long or ValueError(msg)`, so a `too_long`/`too_short` whose
instances are falsy (e.g. an Exception subclass overriding `__bool__`)
was discarded and the default `ValueError` raised instead.

Switch to explicit `is not None` checks, and only build the default
message when no custom exception is supplied so a faulty `__repr__` on
the iterable's items can't shadow the requested exception.
